event.text: You can manage this yourself with over-the-counter allergy options — non-sedating oral antihistamines and steroid-type nasal sprays are sold without a prescription, and if you rinse your nose, use distilled or sterilized water with saline; a pharmacist can help you choose. Your sneezing, itchy eyes and stuffy nose fit your usual seasonal pattern. If you develop trouble breathing, wheezing, or swelling of the lips, tongue or throat, call 911 right away. If instead you get a fever, facial pain or pressure, one-sided nasal blockage, or symptoms that keep worsening or don't settle with these measures, message a clinician for assessment; if that isn't available, see an in-person clinic.
